pairs: Then Tobias responded to his father,
“I will do everything just as you have instructed me,
But I do not know how to obtain this money.
and I do not know him.
What proof shall I give to him?
And I do not know any part of the way,
sed neque viam per quam pergatur illuc aliquando cognovi.
Then his father answered him, and he said:
Chirographum quidem illius penes me habeo:
I have a written agreement about that in my possession,
which, when you show it to him,
et inquire tibi aliquem fidelem virum, qui eat tecum salva mercede sua,
and inquire after some faithful man, who would go with you to keep you safe in return for his wages,
ut dum adhuc vivo, recipias eam.
so that you may receive it while I am still alive.”
invenit juvenem splendidum stantem præcinctum, et quasi paratum ad ambulandum.
found a splendid young man, standing girded and seemingly ready for travel.
Et ignorans quod angelus Dei esset,
And not knowing that he was an Angel of God,
Nosti viam quæ ducit in regionem Medorum?
“Do you know the way that leads to the region of the Medes?”
Novi: et omnia itinera ejus frequenter ambulavi,
“I know it. And I have frequently walked through all its paths,
et mansi apud Gabelum fratrem nostrum,
and I stayed with Gabael, our brother,
qui moratur in Rages civitate Medorum,
who lives in Rages, a city of the Medes,
quæ posita est in monte Ecbatanis.
which is situated at the mount of Ecbatana.”
“I implore you, wait here for me,
donec hæc ipsa nuntiem patri meo.
until I tell these same things to my father.”
revealed all these things to his father.
Upon which, his father, in admiration,
asked that he would enter to him.
And so, entering, he greeted him,
“What kind of gladness will be for me,
and do not see the light of heaven?”
And the young man said to him,
in proximo est ut a Deo cureris.
Your cure from God is near.”
And so Tobit said to him,
Numquid poteris perducere filium meum ad Gabelum in Rages civitatem Medorum?
“Are you able to lead my son to Gabael in Rages, a city of the Medes?
I will pay you your wages.”
And the Angel said to him,
and I will bring him back to you.”
indica mihi de qua domo aut de qua tribu es tu.
which family or which tribe are you from?”
Cui Raphaël angelus dixit: Genus quæris mercenarii,
And Raphael the Angel said, “Do you seek the family of the one you hire,
an ipsum mercenarium qui cum filio tuo eat?
or else the hired hand himself, to go with your son?
sed ne forte sollicitum te reddam,
But, lest perhaps I cause you to worry:
ego sum Azarias Ananiæ magni filius.
I am Azariah, the son of Hananiah the great.”
Sed peto ne irascaris quod voluerim cognoscere genus tuum.
But I ask you, do not be angry that I wanted to know your family.”
But the Angel said to him,
et sanum tibi reducam filium tuum.
and I will bring him back safely to you.”
et sit Deus in itinere vestro,
and may God be with you on your journey,
and may his Angel accompany you.”
Tunc paratis omnibus quæ erant in via portanda,
Then, when all things were ready which were to be carried on their journey,
fecit Tobias vale patri suo et matri suæ,
Tobias said farewell to his father, and to his mother,
and the two of them walked together.
And when they had set out,
“You have taken the staff of our old age,
and you have sent him away from us.
I wish that the money, for which you sent him,
For our poverty has been sufficient for us,
ut divitias computaremus hoc, quod videbamus filium nostrum.
so that we might count it as riches that we saw our son.”
and he will return safely to us,
and your eyes shall see him.
Credo enim quod angelus Dei bonus comitetur ei,
For I believe that the good Angel of God accompanies him
et bene disponat omnia quæ circa eum geruntur,
and that he orders all things well which occur around him,
ita ut cum gaudio revertatur ad nos.
such that he will be returned to us with gladness.”
Ad hanc vocem cessavit mater ejus flere,
At these words, his mother ceased weeping,
